scope: Manga reader zoom gestures aligned with Komikku
Global manga night mode with independent reader brightness
Dotted release versioning for cross-platform updates

komikkuReference.doubleTapZoom: setDoubleTapZoomScale(fitScale * 2) with ZOOM_FOCUS_CENTER; second double tap returns to fit
komikkuReference.panLimit: PAN_LIMIT_INSIDE keeps the image inside the viewport
komikkuReference.gestureArbitration: The page view consumes drags while zoomed so the pager does not steal them
komikkuReference.navigateToPan: Tapping a side zone pans first and only turns the page at the boundary
komikkuReference.brightness: ReaderActivity custom brightness: negative values clamp window brightness to 0.01 and overlay black with alpha = |value|/100

implementation.zoomLayer: lib/features/reader/manga_zoom_view.dart: per-page scale/offset state, pinch with focal anchoring, double tap toggle, clamped pan, ZoomDurationPreset none/fast/normal/slow
implementation.pagerGate: MangaReaderPage switches PageView and the webtoon ScrollablePositionedList to NeverScrollableScrollPhysics while zoomed, so single-finger drags pan the image instead of dragging the page
implementation.tapZones: Side taps pan the zoomed page first (120 px per tap) and only turn the page at the pan boundary; coordinates use globalPosition so double-page spreads keep whole-screen zones
implementation.zoomReset: Page change, chapter switch, mode/layout change and resetToken bump all clear zoom so a magnified page never leaks into the next one
implementation.nightMode: MangaNightMode: enabled + brightness 5..100 percent, presets 100/80/60/40/20/10, scrim alpha = (100 - brightness)/100 capped at 0.95
implementation.nightScope: Black overlay above the page and below the reader chrome; never touches system brightness, no blue-light color shift, disappears on exit with no restore step
implementation.settings: All new options are global and stored in the existing reader.manga key; legacy per-work records remain ignored

newTests: manga_zoom_view_test: clamped pan, focal anchoring, double tap toggle, disabled zoom, resetToken, edge-tap pan
manga_reader_zoom_test: double tap zoom gates pager physics and does not turn pages while dragging; edge taps pan then turn and reset; night scrim appears only when enabled at the selected alpha
manga_reader_settings_test: zoom and night settings persist across a new provider container and reset to defaults

actualAndroid.doubleTapZoom: Real MangaDex chapter page 1/23: double tap expanded the rendered page band from 432-1966 to 151-2399 of 2400 px
actualAndroid.panNotPageTurn: Drag while zoomed shifted the page band from 151-2399 to 0-2309 while the indicator stayed 1/23
actualAndroid.doubleTapRestore: Second double tap returned the page to original size; the reset capture is noisier than the pure 1x capture and is not claimed as pixel-exact
actualAndroid.edgeTap: At 1x, left edge advanced 1/23 to 2/23 in the default right-to-left mode
actualAndroid.nightDimming: Matched captures at the same page and position: off mean luminance 154.6, 20 percent 30.9 (ratio 0.20 matching an 80 percent black scrim)
actualAndroid.deviceBrightnessUnchanged: settings get system screen_brightness stayed 102 across enabling, using and closing night mode
actualAndroid.settingsPersistAfterRestart: force-stop and relaunch kept night mode enabled with the 20 percent preset; nightly value is a user choice, the test left the emulator in the state it verified
actualAndroid.doubleTapRestore: Deterministic cycle with the reader chrome hidden at the same 20 percent night setting: 1x page band 432-1965, after the first double tap the page is magnified, after the second double tap the band returns to exactly 432-1965
actualAndroid.visualLimit: Measurements come from decoded screenshots and accessibility nodes; no human pixel-visual claim, and captures were taken at 20 percent reader brightness only

versionPolicy.rule: Cross-platform Android and Windows updates publish the dotted version only; only single-platform follow-ups append +N
versionPolicy.buildNumber: pubspec still carries a monotonically increasing build number for Android/Windows installer comparison
